configuration: VC2-S-AP2 Victory cargo ship, 1945 arrangement; 6000 shp geared steam turbine

sources.title: National Park Service — HAER CA-345, Winthrop Victory drawings, 2010
sources.pages: HAER sheets 2, 3 and 6 (zero-based PDF pages 2, 3 and 6): profile, decks, sheer/half-breadth/body plan
sources.supports: 455 ft 3 in × 62 ft Victory hull and distinct forecastle, cargo kingposts, deckhouses and hull lines.
sources.limits: Drawn in 2010 from historical drawings/photos; not an original 1945 builder package and not a certification of the laid-up 2010 fit.
sources.provenance: US National Park Service / Library of Congress HAER, mirrored by Internet Archive. Reference drawings only.

independence: Only independently authored blueprint, versioned original recipe and original component catalog feed the model. Scans are comparison references; no third-party mesh, texture or GameModels3D asset is used.
